text: APPROVE. The extracted helpers keep the original filtering and branching (the in-loop `continue` becomes a trailing `return`), and the definite assignment of `entry` after the `||` guard compiles. The nested conditions that drove the score are gone, so the method should now be under 15. I could not see the declared types of `resolved` and `direct`, so the build rests on those matching the new `Dictionary<string, string>` and `List<string>` parameters.
